thread:
Alex C.: Hey team — PR #22144 is blocked: macOS snapshot mismatch + intermittent e2e failure on shard-5. I pushed the updated golden images but CI still shows a timeout in test_ui_render. Can someone with macOS runner access kick a targeted rerun? cc @Maria G. @Samir
Samir: I can queue a rerun in ~10m. Is this just a snapshot update or did you change test logic?
Alex C.: Only assets changed (pngs). The failing line in the logs is `TimeoutError: Waited 30s for element`. Looks flaky. Snapshot diff is legitimate but want green CI before merging.
Maria G.: I don't have repo approvals here (new repo perms). If this is only snapshot, can we add the `ci-snapshot-ok` label so infra can skip the approval gate?
Alex C.: Added label `ci-snapshot-ok` :white_check_mark:.
Jen L.: If it's a timing flake maybe we should increase the harness wait to 45s, but let's rerun first. If it keeps failing I'll open a follow-up to bump the timeout.
CI Bot: targeted-rerun triggered by Samir — macos-11 shard-5 — build: https://ci.internal/redwood/22144/targeted-rerun/5
Samir: kicked the rerun — watching logs now.
CI Bot: macos-11 shard-5 rerun finished — status: flaky (1/3 failures isolated). Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/22144/targeted-rerun/5/logs
Alex C.: Hmm still flaky. The failure happens ~40s in. Jen, can you open a quick PR to extend wait or should I?
Jen L.: I'll branch a small change to increase wait and include a comment referencing this thread. Won't touch snapshots.
Maria G.: I can approve once one green macOS run completes. Ping me when CI shows green.
Jen L.: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/pr/22145 — increases wait to 45s for flaky selector.
CI Bot: PR 22145 queued — running macos lanes.
CI Bot: PR 22145 macos-11 shard-5 — build passed ✅
Maria G.: Approved and added `ci-ok` label.
Samir: reran PR 22144 with snapshot label and approval present. Build: https://ci.internal/redwood/22144/merge-check
CI Bot: PR 22144 merge-check — macos lanes: all green ✅ — ready to merge
Alex C.: Thanks everyone — merging in ~30m to avoid overlap with the afternoon deploys. I'll keep an eye on prod dashboards.
Samir: thx all :rocket:
Jen L.: filing a short postmortem note in the PR about the flake pattern and the wait change.
Alex C.: Good call. Closing loop here.
